title: Error when running linter
body:
When I try to run `npm run lint`, I have the following error:

```
Error: algolia:
        Configuration for rule "no-cond-assign" is invalid:
        Severity should be one of the following: 0 = off, 1 = warning, 2 = error (you passed "error").
```

Same error occurs if I try to use `"eslint-config-algolia": "^5.1.0"` in another project. Looks like the syntax (now?) expect you to pass `2` instead of `error` in the eslint config.
